tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Free: status (success, failed, pending), block, confirmations, fee, what kind of transaction it is, and how many red flags it has, without the details. About 20 calls a minute per client.

Permit2), protocols touched, and red flags: unlimited or wallet ap
